faq: No. Privacy rules, blockers and people switching devices make some paths invisible. The review shows trends and big gaps, not perfect truth, and we state how reliable each finding is.
What do you need to run the review?
View access to Google Analytics, your ad accounts and your store, plus any email tool in use. Three months of data is ideal. We do not need to change anything in your accounts.
Will you tell me to cut a channel?

Only if the data supports it. Some channels start the journey and look weak in last-click reports. We separate channels that bring new buyers from ones that only close orders, so you do not cut the wrong one.
Is this useful if my tracking is a mess?
Partly. Messy tracking limits what we can say, so the report lists the gaps first. The Tracking Audit or Data Cleanup service then fixes the base before you act on conclusions.
